item.title: AI controls fusion plasma faster than human reaction time
item.description: Princeton researchers tested an AI system that monitors and controls fusion plasma in milliseconds, outperforming human operators in speed.

item.title: 80,000-year-old projectile points may rewrite human history
item.description: Archaeologists found tiny 80,000-year-old projectile points in Uzbekistan that may have been used as arrowheads, with their design suggesting advanced hunting techniques.
